verdict.rationale: Background automation is a fair question for a customer data platform, but the evidence pack does not document a capability for users to set up automations that run on their own. The closest items are adjacent: audience-to-output connections, consent-based forwarding rules, Warehouse Sync ingestion and AI-suggested audience logic. None of these describes a user-defined recurring schedule, trigger-based workflow or autonomous background agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
